output.source_text: In Queen's 'Seaside Rendezvous', the Bdim chord is used as a descending diatonic stepping stone in the key of C major (progression: Dm - C - Bdim - Am - G). On keyboard, this is executed by sliding the same triad shape down the white keys step-by-step.

note_vi: Bài 37 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 01:21-02:04. In Queen's 'Seaside Rendezvous', the Bdim chord is used as a descending diatonic stepping stone in the key of C major (progression: Dm - C - Bdim - Am - G). On keyboard, this is executed by sliding the same triad shape down the white keys step-by-step. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
